Subject: Gesture wall prop & mass collateral kit — initial logistics

Hi team —

Following up from the design sync: TechSummit confirmed a 12ft vertical demo zone where we want to install the "gesture wall" prop (interactive LED panel) and ship a bulk kit of collateral (500 brochures, 200 postcards, 6 demo units, 3 pop-up banners). Need to lock the following by end of day Friday so we can finalize crate labels and pallet counts for the carrier:  

- Final footprint and mounting holes for the gesture wall (I attached an initial dim spec)
- Confirm whether the gesture wall arrives assembled or in two crates (weight per crate needs to be under 68kg for the dock)
- Palletization manifest for the collateral kit (we expect 2 pallets + 1 small crate for demo units)
- On-site install window: is Saturday night acceptable or do we need an earlier slot?

Kate from TechSummit looped in freight/rigging: Kate, if you can confirm dock hours and whether on-site riggers will accept assembled frames, that would help.

Attachments: gesture-wall-dimensions.pdf, bulk-collateral-manifest-v1.xlsx

Mina

Mina / Marissa —

Operational constraints from the venue + our carrier:

- Dock weight limit: 70kg per hand-carriable crate. If the frame breaks into two sections at ~62kg each (Marissa's number), we are good but we must specify crate handles and internal bracing.
- Freight window: Monday–Wednesday 08:00–16:00 for ground unload. Saturday night install is allowed only if we book an "after-hours" rigging crew (additional $420 flat). TechSummit, can you confirm whether the sponsor rate covers after-hours?
- Palletization: collateral needs to be boxed in multiples of 50 brochures per carton. That gives us exactly 10 cartons per pallet + 1 pallet of demo units (foam-sealed). See attached palletization-guidelines.pdf for labeling and shrink-wrap orientation.

I'll prep the carrier manifest once Marissa confirms final crate dimensions and Mina signs off on after-hours or changes install to Monday morning.

Attachments: palletization-guidelines.pdf

Jonas Weber
Logistics Program Manager, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

Thanks for the quick turn. Consolidating next steps and decisions so we can close the manifest: 

1) Crating: proceed with two-section crates for the gesture wall (per Marissa dims). Jonas: specify crate handles + internal bracing; mark both crates EVENT-KIT-TS-20280226-001 and EVENT-KIT-TS-20280226-002.
2) Pallet counts: follow Jonas's recommendation — 2 pallets of brochures (50 boxes each), 1 pallet of demo units, 3 loose crates for banners/wraps. Attachments updated in drive.
3) Install window: Kate, we'll take Saturday night only if TechSummit covers after-hours rigging fee. If not confirmed by EOD Monday we'll reschedule install for Monday morning 07:30–10:30 (carrier prefers early AM).
4) Branding: Marissa signed off on artwork; Alicia (SignWorks) — please confirm the wrap file is print-ready and confirm lead time for overnight printing (we may need rush).

Action items: 
- Jonas: prepare carrier manifest and truck booking (due Mon 20:00 PST).
